cards.name: hero
cards.title: Who liked my comment? **Don’t tap the heart**
cards.sub: A tap likes the comment. Press and hold it to open the list of everyone who liked it.

right.label: Press and hold (or tap the count)
items: Works on comments you can see
Nobody is notified that you looked

cards.name: steps
cards.title: See who liked a comment in **4 steps**

steps.title: Open comments
steps.text: Tap the speech bubble or View all comments.

steps.title: Find the heart
steps.text: A number with it means the comment has likes.

steps.title: Press and hold
steps.text: Hold for a second. Don’t tap.

steps.title: Browse the list
steps.text: Tap any name to open the profile.

cards.name: notified
cards.title: Who knows when you **like a comment?**

left.label: Can find out
items: Anyone who opens the like list

right.label: Not told
items: The person whose list you opened

cards.name: bottom-line
cards.quote: Press and hold, don’t tap. Then turn your **most-liked comments into your next posts.**
cards.by: Every popular comment is a question your audience wants answered.
